title: Section 701.6 - Revise the opening paragraph in Section 701.6 to read as follows:
officialText:
701.6 Signals. Where required by the New York City Building Code, audible and visual signal devices shall be
provided for the purposes described in 701.6(A) through (D), and shall announce at a constantly attended location.
